acceptanceCriteria: Root cause confirmed: identify which concurrent writer or ordering produces a lane phase change that program.go:133 refuses as MALFORMED 'program transition' in a fake-host program test (test race versus product defect).

`GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=20 -run 'TestCALV0075_ClaudeCodeProgramFakeHost|TestCALV0077_OpenCodeProgramFakeHost' ./internal/tasks/store/` passes under concurrent host load (load average comparable to 40+).

If it is a product defect, a regression test reproduces the refused transition deterministically and proves the fix; if it is test-only, the test waits on an observed program state rather than timing.
body:
Observed 2026-10-05 by the V1-0756 lane agent (OpenCode supervisor host, branch claude/v1-0756-opencode-host at 3516d73d, on top of V1-0755 3992d096). Go 1.27.1 darwin/arm64, with sibling lanes running package tests on the same host.

The fake-host program tests in internal/tasks/store intermittently fail with "MALFORMED: transaction: program transition", which internal/tasks/transaction/program.go:133 returns when a lane's next phase is not in the allowed transition map and the change is not recovering, control-only, binding or reassign. It hit TestCALV0077_OpenCodeProgramFakeHost once and the sibling TestCALV0075_ClaudeCodeProgramFakeHost once. Rerun alone, 12 of 12 pass.

Expected: a supervised program run under a fake host only makes allowed lane transitions, independent of load. Actual: under load a transition outside the map is sometimes attempted and refused.

Unconfirmed: whether the base (before V1-0755) shows it; whether this is a lost-update/ordering race in the program runner (product defect) or a test-only artifact. Separately observed once in the same run: TestCALV0071 multi-repo failed with "context canceled" (not investigated). Related load-sensitivity tickets: V1-0724 (PSR/store tests), V1-0768 (TestATRV0004 SURVIVORS).
title: Suspected race: supervised program fake-host tests intermittently refused as MALFORMED program transition under load
